sources.observed: Official Overview: SKU USW-Enterprise-24-PoE; dimensions width 442, depth 325, height 44 mm; rack mount 1U; 12 x 1GbE + 12 x 2.5GbE; 2 x 10G SFP+ cages. Technical section identifies integrated AC supply and DC backup. Current rounded dimensions retained; no electrical circuit or telemetry is simulated.
Exact selected SKU; names and type counts crosschecked against the official technical specifications. Community elevation pictures remain unverified references.

evidence.dimensionsBasis: Nominal chassis dimensions from the current official Overview, in W x H x D mm. Older community/QSG decimals are not silently substituted; mounting ears, tolerances and ventilation are not certified.
limits: Own planar approximation from the inspected community front and rear elevations; community_unverified identity is retained. No photograph is used as an operational background.

Current official nominal dimensions are used. Older QSG/community descriptions can differ by rounding (442/442.4, 44/43.7, 285/285.4, 400/399.6 mm). No fit, loading, tolerance or cooling certification is implied.
Fixed copper ports and empty SFP+ cages are materialized; no transceiver, DAC, breakout, speed negotiation, module or optional device is installed.
One integrated AC inlet is operational under the existing broad power-role contract. Proprietary RPS/DC backup is explicitly decorative and never mapped as an AC endpoint.
The LCD, reset, indicators, fans and Etherlighting-style details are static drawing elements, not measured state. The body color is an approximation, not calibrated colorimetry.
Factory port numbers are visual labels. Each endpoint identity remains the original group key plus ordinal and its later instance UUID; no connection is keyed by a displayed number.
PoE capabilities are documented by the manufacturer but are not automatically applied as per-port PSE state or a simulated power budget by this profile.
